check_torch_view: check if a PyTorch tensor is a non-contiguous view or shares underlying storage
dump_numpy_memmap: dump a numpy array to a shared binary file and load it back via memory mapping
dump_torch_tensor: dump a PyTorch tensor to a shared binary file using the MemmapArray handler protocol
dump_auto_recursive: recursively serialize a nested dict or list by dispatching registered type handlers and storing via JSON or Pickle
dump_json_inline_or_shared: serialize a JSON-serializable value inline if small or to a shared JSONL file if large
